name: CredentialRequirements Issuer
description: Issues a Membership Card only after a valid National ID has been presented
summary: Minimal NOOP wallet illustrating a CredentialRequirements issuer: issuance proceeds only after the holder presents a required credential. Here a Membership Card (jwt_vc_vcdm) is issued only once the holder presents a valid National ID, referenced by issuerConfiguration.credentialVerifierId. Unlike a VPDriven issuer there is no mapping: nothing is copied into the new credential, the presentation is a gate. Specific required field values (for example firstName = John) are supplied per request at CredentialIssuanceInit. Works only with the in-time authorized issuance flow.
